title: Project
description: A software project and the role held on it. Each record is one JSON file under projects/.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema, so editors can validate and autocomplete the record.

url.description: Primary link for the project, such as its source repository or homepage.

role.description: Role held on the project, e.g. "Lead Developer" or "Contributor".

priority.description: Display order on the website: lower values are listed first, and ties are broken by name.

logo.description: Logo displayed above the project entry.

src.description: Path to the image relative to the website root (the file itself lives under src/public/), e.g. "img/guide_logo.png".

widthPercent.description: Displayed width as a percentage of the content column.

description.description: Plain-text paragraphs describing the project and the contributions made to it.
